description: Business rules of the Topia -> Equus EAFH transformation. A rule changes import output only while approved_for_import is true; a Jake answer is evidence, not approval (every tracker Status in clarifications/jake-1.xlsx column I is Open). Validated strictly by mapping_config.load_business_rules().

dependent_source.owner: Alka / Topia (keyed dependent extract, D3); Jake (Equus layout)
dependent_source.notes: Q11/Q18/Q19 (Jake): dependents go in the same import, linked to their assignment by the Assignment Identifier. The Topia 'Dependent Import' sheet has no Employee/Assignment key (assessment D3), so no keyed sheet is configured (sheet null) and any dependent sheet without key columns is reported HELD_DEPENDENTS_UNKEYED. Set sheet, the row numbers and the key column labels once Topia delivers a keyed extract, then approved_for_import after review. The join is by Assignment ID only, never by Employee Number.
